name: Wmns Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Orchid'
story_html: The Women's Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Orchid' is crafted from lilac-colored suede with breathable quarter panel netting and grey molded eyelets. Speckled detailing enlivens the TPU support wings and molded back tab, marked with classic Jumpman branding, as well as the lightweight polyurethane midsole. Encapsulated Air-sole cushioning is nestled in the forefoot, while the heel is fitted with an exposed Air bag.
